anchor: 又河東行八百餘里，至殑伽河源
end_anchor: 後提婆菩薩示其正理，方始停絕。
note: Shares the Ganges-source passage of 04.09.03 (Śrughna); the Life has no account of the four rivers of Anavatapta.

anchor: 自烏鐸迦漢茶城南渡信渡河
end_anchor: 有持印度奇寶名花及舍利渡者，船輒覆沒。
note: Indus at the Udakhāṇḍa crossing (name 信渡河): 3–4 li wide, poisonous dragons, boats with relics or flowers capsize; on the return (fasc. 5) the river is 5–6 li wide and 50 bundles of sūtras and the seeds are lost.

anchor: 池西分出一河，西至達摩悉鐵帝國
note: Return journey (fasc. 5): a river from the great dragon lake of the Pamir joins the 縛芻河 and flows west to the sea; the Oxus is otherwise only crossed (Khwarazm, Kunduz) in fasc. 2.

anchor: 池東分一大河，東至佉沙國西界
note: Return journey (fasc. 5): a river from the Pamir dragon lake joins the 徙多河 at the western border of Kashgar and flows east.
The Life names the 阿耨池 only once, as lying north–south of the Pamir dragon lake; no Gandhamādana.

anchor: 城依峻嶺，北背從多河
end_anchor: 出積石山，為此國河源也。
note: Return journey, Kabhanda (fasc. 5): the river (name form 從多河) enters the salt marsh, flows underground and emerges at 積石山 as the source of "this country's" river, i.e. the Yellow River theory of the Xiyu ji.

anchor: 東進行六百餘里，越黑嶺，入北印度境
note: The Black Ridge as the boundary of North India, crossed between Kapiśī and Lampā (shares 02.02); the Life has no ethnographic preface.

anchor: 於是遂行，涉南磧，經六日，至高昌界白力城
end_anchor: 王始還宮，留數黃門侍宿。
note: Arrival at 白力城 and the night arrival at the royal city only; the Life then narrates a stay of over a month (Qu Wentai's attempt to detain him, his hunger strike, the Renwang jing lectures, letters to 24 kingdoms, the departure) not included.

anchor: 從此西行至阿耆尼國阿父師泉
note: Fasc. 1 ends with entry via 無半城 and 篤進城. Adds the 阿父師泉 legend, the Silver Mountain (source of the western silver coins), robbers who killed merchants who went ahead, and the king's refusal of horses because of Gaochang raids; stayed one night.

anchor: 漸去遙見王都，阿耆尼王與諸臣來迎
note: The king meets him outside the capital; the night before they camp on the river bank where the royal city lies.

anchor: 前渡二大河，西履平川，行數百里，入屈支國界
note: Distance only 數百里 (Xiyu ji 200 + 700 li). Reception by king and Mokṣagupta with flowers and grape juice; a monastery of Gaochang monks south-east of the city. Stops before the debate (see 01.06.04); stayed 60+ days waiting for the Ling Shan pass.

anchor: 食訖，過城西北阿奢理兒寺
note: Name 阿奢理兒寺, north-west of the city, residence of Mokṣagupta; the debate on the Yogācārabhūmi and Kośa, the 60-day wait for the snow road; none of the Xiyu ji's legend of the temple.

anchor: 從此西行二日，逢突厥寇賊二千餘騎
note: Adds 2,000 Turkish raiders who quarrelled over the booty and dispersed; 600 li and small desert as in the Xiyu ji; one night only.

anchor: 又西北行三百里，渡一磧，至淩山
note: Seven days in the mountains; three or four in ten of the party froze to death, more of the animals. The Xiyu ji gives 400 li of mountain road.

anchor: 出山後至一清池周千四五百里
note: Circuit 1,400–1,500 li (Xiyu ji 千餘里).

anchor: 循海西北行五百餘里，至素葉城
note: Name 素葉城. Meeting with the Yabghu Qaghan (hunting), his tent camp, the banquet, his warning about the heat of India, and the interpreter who escorts Xuanzang to Kapiśī; no description of the city.
The Life has no general account of Sogdiana (窣利).

anchor: 自此西行四百餘里，至屏聿
note: Name 屏聿 (Turkic bing yul) glossed 千泉; 數百里 square (Xiyu ji 二百餘里).

anchor: 自屏聿西百五十里，至呾邏斯城。
end_anchor: 自屏聿西百五十里，至呾邏斯城。
note: Named only. Name 呾邏斯; 150 li (Xiyu ji 140–150).

anchor: 又西南二百里，至白水城。
end_anchor: 又西南二百里，至白水城。
note: Named only.

end_anchor: 又西南二百里，至恭御城。
note: Named only.

end_anchor: 又南五十里，至笯赤建國。
note: Named only; 50 li (Xiyu ji 40–50).

anchor: 又西二百里，至赭時國
note: Named only.

anchor: 國西臨葉葉河
note: Name 葉葉河; west of Chāch and east of Sutrishna, rising in the northern Pamirs.
Ferghana is not on the Life's route: it goes from Chāch straight to Sutrishna.

anchor: 又西千餘里，至窣堵利瑟那國
note: From Chāch 1,000 li west; the Xiyu ji counts the 1,000 li from Ferghana.

anchor: 又西北入大磧，無水草
end_anchor: 望遺骨而進五百餘里，至颯秣建國。
note: Briefer than the Xiyu ji; same 500 li.

anchor: 又西北入大磧，無水草
end_anchor: 其革變邪心，誘開曚俗，所到如此。
note: Adds an event: the fire-worshipping king, two empty monasteries, the attack on Xuanzang's novices, the king's conversion and the first ordinations.
Only "逐出都外" in the Samarkand episode.

anchor: 又西三百餘里，至屈霜儞迦國。
end_anchor: 又西三百餘里，至屈霜儞迦國。
note: Named only; 300 li west counted from Samarkand (the Xiyu ji counts from Kapūtana).

anchor: 又西二百餘里，至喝捍國。
end_anchor: 又西二百餘里，至喝捍國。
note: Named only.

anchor: 又西四百里，至捕喝國。
note: Named only.

anchor: 又西百餘里，至伐地國。
note: Named only; 100+ li (Xiyu ji 400+).

anchor: 又西五百里，至貨利習彌伽國
note: Named only; due west 500 li (Xiyu ji south-west); "east bordering the Oxus".

anchor: 又西南三百餘里，至羯霜那國。
end_anchor: 又西南三百餘里，至羯霜那國。
note: Named only. The Life chains it from Khwarazm (SW 300 li), whereas the Xiyu ji counts the 300 li from Samarkand: the Life linearizes the Xiyu ji's side list.

anchor: 又西南二百里入山
note: South-west 200 li then 300 li of mountain path (Xiyu ji: south-east 300 li); iron ore in the cliffs; a Turkish frontier post.

anchor: 出鐵門至覩貨羅國。
note: Named only; no general account of Tukhāra.

anchor: 自此數百里渡縛芻河，至活國
note: Seat of Tardu Shad, the Yabghu's eldest son and Qu Wentai's brother-in-law: his poisoning and the usurpation, a month's delay, the debate with Dharmasaṃgha. Visited again on the return (fasc. 5), there placed on the south bank of the Oxus.

anchor: 既至，觀其城邑，郊郭顯敞
end_anchor: 覩法師神彩明秀，極加敬仰。
note: Reached on the advice of Balkh monks (the new Shad called it "little Rājagṛha"). Includes the Nava monastery and Trapuṣa/Bhallika sites (01.32.01–02) and Prajñākara of Ṭakka, under whom he read the Vibhāṣā for a month.

anchor: 城外西南有納縛伽藍
note: Name 納縛伽藍; same relics (basin, tooth, broom).

anchor: 大城西北五十里，至提謂城
note: Two stupas of 3 zhang in Pāli city (the Xiyu ji has one in each city); adds a Kāśyapa stupa 70 li west.

anchor: 時縛喝西南有銳末陀、胡寔健國
note: Name 銳末陀; their kings invite him and he goes reluctantly and refuses gifts: an actual visit, which the Xiyu ji does not mark.

anchor: 時縛喝西南有銳末陀、胡寔健國
note: Shares 01.33.

anchor: 自縛喝南行，與慧性法師相隨入揭職國。
end_anchor: 自縛喝南行，與慧性法師相隨入揭職國。
note: Named only; travelling with the Tukhāra monk Huixing.

anchor: 東南入大雪山，行六百餘里
note: The snow road harder than the Ling Shan; Lokottaravāda monks; welcomed by the king and two Mahāsāṃghika teachers.

anchor: 王城東北山阿有立石像
note: 150 chi (Xiyu ji 140–150).

anchor: 像東有伽藍，伽藍東有鍮石釋迦立像
伽藍內有佛入涅槃臥像
note: Inside the monastery east of the standing image; the Xiyu ji puts the reclining image in a monastery 2–3 li east of the city.

anchor: 此東南行二百餘里，度大雪山至小川
如是經十五日出梵衍
note: Fifteen days to leave Bāmiyān, lost in snow, a hunter shows the way over a small sand ridge, then the Black Mountains (黑山).

anchor: 周四千餘里，北背雪山
note: Kṣatriya king ruling over ten countries; monasteries compete to host him. Later in the passage: the 5-day Mahāyāna assembly and the summer retreat at Śalaka (01.38.01).

anchor: 有一小乘寺名沙落迦
note: Name 沙落迦; Xuanzang himself opens the treasure under the guardian's foot (gold and pearls) to repair the stupa; summer retreat there.

anchor: 將至其都，王共諸僧並出城來迎

note: The Life has no general account of India; only "入北印度境" at the Black Ridge.

anchor: 東進行六百餘里，越黑嶺，入北印度境
note: Stayed three days; adds the small-ridge stupa south of the country, the limit of the mleccha lands. On the return Xuanzang stays at Lampā (fasc. 5, see 02.02a).

anchor: 法師與迦畢試王相隨西北行
end_anchor: 時王亦為七十五日無遮大施。
note: Return journey: name 藍波; the capital receives him with banners; he stays at a Mahāyāna monastery during the king's 75-day great alms-giving.

anchor: 從此南二十餘里，下嶺濟河
note: Only 20+ li south of the small ridge (Xiyu ji: south-east 100+ li); includes the Dīpaṃkara stupa (02.03.02) and the flower-buying stupa.

anchor: 至燈光城，入一伽藍問訪途路
note: The Life calls the capital 燈光城 (Dīpaṃkara city).

anchor: 大城東南二里有窣堵波
note: Adds Xuanzang's question how the trace survives the destruction of the world and the old monk's answer.

anchor: 又聞燈光城西南二十餘里
note: Long event: he goes alone against the Kapiśī escort's wishes, converts five robbers, and after some 200 prostrations sees the shadow; ends with the robbers taking the precepts.

anchor: 又東南度沙嶺十餘里，到佛頂骨城
note: Called 佛頂骨城; SE 10+ li over a sand ridge from the flower-buying stupa (Xiyu ji 30 li SE of the capital). Adds the divination with scented paste (Xuanzang obtains a Bodhi tree) and his donations.

anchor: 從此復與伴合，東南山行五百餘里
note: Lists the śāstra masters born here (Nārāyaṇadeva, Asaṅga, Vasubandhu, Dharmatrāta, Manoratha, Pārśva).

anchor: 其國東臨信度河，都城號布路沙布羅
end_anchor: 其國東臨信度河，都城號布路沙布羅。
note: Name 布路沙布羅; named only.

anchor: 王城東北有置佛鉢寶臺
note: Bowl now in 波剌拏斯 (Vārāṇasī; the Xiyu ji says Persia); the pippala tree 8–9 li south-east of the city.

anchor: 其側又有窣堵波，是迦膩色迦王所造
end_anchor: 往往有人見像夜遶大塔經行。
note: Includes the white stone image south-west of the stupa.

anchor: 迦膩色迦伽藍東北百餘里
end_anchor: 渡大河至布色羯羅伐底城
note: Only named in passing, as the starting point for Puṣkalāvatī.

anchor: 迦膩色迦伽藍東北百餘里
note: 100+ li from the Kaniṣka monastery (Xiyu ji 50+ li); includes the stupa of the thousand eye-gifts north of the city.

anchor: 停七日，又西北行三日至信度大河
note: Return journey: sūtras and seeds lost in the Indus; the king of Kapiśī waits at Udakhāṇḍa, Xuanzang stays 50+ days and sends to Uḍḍiyāna to recopy the Kāśyapīya canon. On the outward journey only "從此又到烏鐸迦漢荼城".

anchor: 城北陟履山川，行六百餘里，入烏仗那國夾蘇婆薩堵河
note: 1,400 monasteries and 18,000 monks formerly, now decayed; five vinaya schools.

anchor: 其王多居瞢揭釐城，人物豐盛。
end_anchor: 其王多居瞢揭釐城，人物豐盛。
note: Named only.

end_anchor: 入烏仗那國夾蘇婆薩堵河。
note: Named in passing (蘇婆薩堵河); the Apalāla spring is called its upper source (03.01.03).

anchor: 城東四五里有大窣堵波

note: 250 li (Xiyu ji 250–260); same description of cold and coloured snow.

anchor: 龍泉西南三十餘里

瞢揭釐城西五十里渡大河
note: Height 10+ zhang (Xiyu ji 50+ chi).

anchor: 城東北三十餘里，至遏部多石窣堵波
note: Height 30 chi (Xiyu ji 40+).

anchor: 塔西渡大河三四里至一精舍
note: 3–4 li across the river (Xiyu ji 30–40 li).

anchor: 城東北聞說有人登越山谷
note: Hearsay (聞說). Route up the 徙多河 (Xiyu ji: up the Indus), 1,000 li; 達麗羅 the old capital; wooden Maitreya 100+ chi by Madhyāntika.

anchor: 川南山外有鉢露羅國
note: Return journey, Pamir passage (fasc. 5): only that Bolor lies beyond the mountains south of the Pamir valley and is rich in gold and silver.

anchor: 自烏鐸迦漢茶城南渡信渡河
note: Includes the Indus crossing (01.01b) and the stupa of the thousand heads with Kumāralāta's monastery (03.03.04). Revisited on the return: "重禮月光王捨千頭處", 7 days, Kashmir 50 yojana NE.

anchor: 其城北十二三里有窣堵波
note: The king is named 戰達羅鉢剌婆 (Candraprabha); Kumāralāta composed his treatises in the adjacent monastery.

anchor: 烏地王遣人引送，西行二十餘日，至僧訶補羅國
note: Return journey: 20+ days west of Jālandhara; 100 northern monks join him. On the outward journey only hearsay: "從此東南七百餘里聞，有僧訶補羅國".

anchor: 又從呾叉始羅北界渡信度河
note: Placed (as in the Xiyu ji) 200 li south-east of the Indus crossing at Taxila's northern border; Mahāsattva feeds seven tiger cubs (烏擇 for 於菟).

anchor: 又從此東南山行五百餘里，至烏剌尸國。
end_anchor: 又從此東南山行五百餘里，至烏剌尸國。
note: Named only.

anchor: 又東南登危險，度鐵橋，行千餘里
note: Arrival through the stone gate (west gate), the night at 護瑟迦羅寺 with the monks' dream, the royal reception at the 達摩舍羅. Stops before the long account of his study under Saṃghayaśas, the dragon-lake origin legend and Kaniṣka's council (as in the Xiyu ji); stayed two years.

anchor: 其都城西臨大河，伽藍百所

note: Saṃghabhadra appears in the Life only at Matipura (04.10), his death place.

anchor: 西南逾涉山㵎，行七百里，至半笯嗟國。
end_anchor: 西南逾涉山㵎，行七百里，至半笯嗟國。

end_anchor: 從此東南行四百餘里，至遏邏闍補羅國。
note: Named only; name 遏邏闍補羅 (曷邏闍補羅 later in the same passage).

anchor: 從此東南下山渡水行七百餘里，至礫迦國

note: Name 礫迦. Events: night at a non-Buddhist temple in 闍耶補羅城, Śākala, the robbery by 50 bandits in the Palāśa forest, the 700-year-old brahmin (a disciple of Nāgārjuna) at a city in the east, with whom he studied the Śataśāstra for a month.

anchor: 後日進到奢羯羅城
note: A monastery of 100 monks where Vasubandhu wrote the 勝義諦論, and a 200-chi stupa of the four past Buddhas.

anchor: 又從此東行五百餘里，至那僕底國
note: Name 那僕底 (至 dropped by haplography). Fourteen months under Vinītaprabha at the 突舍薩那寺.

anchor: 大城東南行五十餘里，至答秣蘇伐那僧伽藍
note: 50+ li from the capital (Xiyu ji 500+ li).

anchor: 從此東北行百四五十里，至闍爛達那國
note: Name 闍爛達那; four months under Candravarman at the 那伽羅馱那寺. On the return (闍蘭達國, "royal capital of North India") he stayed a month.

end_anchor: 從此東北行登履危嶮，行七百餘里，至屈露多國。

end_anchor: 從此西南行八百餘里，至波理夜呾羅國。
note: Named only.

anchor: 從此東行五百餘里，至秣兔羅國
note: Name 秣兔羅; the relic stupas of the disciples and the schools that worship each.

anchor: 城東五六里至一山伽藍

note: Named only.

anchor: 又東行四百餘里，至祿勒那國
note: Name 祿勒那; due east (Xiyu ji north-east). Includes the Ganges source (04.09.03); stayed a winter and half a spring with Jayagupta.

end_anchor: 後提婆菩薩示其正理，方始停絕。
note: Same 800 li as the Xiyu ji, but the Life's "又河東行" makes it read as a stage of the route.

anchor: 渡河東岸至秣底補羅國
note: Includes Guṇaprabha's monastery, Saṃghabhadra's death place and stupa, Vimalamitra's death; half a spring and a summer with Mitrasena.

end_anchor: 又從此北行三百餘里，至婆羅吸摩補羅國。

end_anchor: 又南行二百餘里，渡殑伽河，西南至毘羅那拏國。

anchor: 又東行二百餘里，至劫比他國。
end_anchor: 又東行二百餘里，至劫比他國。
